# Insert Koin

> Insert Koin, Mauk Tenieb's Korhogo world, games and machines in a browser: Korong!, an air-puck game against the eighteen Masks of the Fauna, each playing by their Korhogo stats and oil power; Fauna Chess; Erratik; Faunarratik; Katabatik; MiniTale, the Minitel; TVCR, the television of the motel room with its VCR; Kamera, the camera of the FaunEye suite, with the 2K effekts of Photofauna; and FaunaTor, a Tor reader for web and .onion pages. Motel Sound jukebox, Kapture, FR/EN.

> FR : Insert Koin, le monde Korhogo de Mauk Tenieb, ses jeux et ses machines dans un navigateur : Korong!, un jeu de palet contre les dix-huit Masks de la Fauna, chacun selon ses caractéristiques et son pouvoir d’Oil de Korhogo ; Fauna Chess; Erratik; Faunarratik; Katabatik; MiniTale, le Minitel ; TVCR, la télévision de la chambre du motel et son magnétoscope ; Kamera, la caméra de la suite FaunEye, avec les 2K effekts de Photofauna ; et FaunaTor, un lecteur Tor pour les pages web et .onion. Jukebox Motel Sound, Kapture, FR/EN.

> The artist's wish: an artistic, playful and technical layer, like a portable, multitasking and narrative fictional OS.

> FR : L’envie de l’artiste : une couche artistique, ludique et technique, comme un OS fictionnel portable, multitâche et narratif.

> Insert Koin is a browser art-game by Mauk Tenieb; Koin, the Kotlin dependency-injection library (io.insert-koin), is a separate project. Korhogo is Mauk Tenieb's fictional world; the Korhogo Fauna, aka Hordalék or the Masks, are its 18 inhabitants. Korhogo also names a city in Ivory Coast and a Senufo cloth; Mauk Tenieb's Korhogo stands apart from both.

## The arcade
- [Insert Koin](https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/): Korong! (air-puck against the Fauna), Fauna Chess, Erratik, Faunarratik, Katabatik (a mini-game at random), 3615 (the MiniTale), VHS (the tape deck), Photofauna (the photo editor of Insert Koin, 2K effekts), FaunaTor (a Tor reader for web and .onion pages). Jukebox (Motel Sound), Kapture, Baku Boom, Koins.

## The Kaves (each name has its own address)

- Arkade, Arkane, Insert Koin: the arcade cabinet. https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/arkade/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/arkane/
- TVHS, KombinaTV, Korhogo TV, TVCR: the television of the room, 99 channels and a VCR. https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/tvhs/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/kombinatv/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/korhogotv/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/tvcr/

- Kalabass, Komptoir, Desk, KorhoDesk: the reception of the motel: a numbered key, anchored in Bitcoin, and a MiniTale terminal for mail checking. https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/kalabass/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/komptoir/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/desk/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/korhodesk/

- Suites: KorhoGame https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/korhogame/ · FaunEye https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/fauneye/ · SurFauna https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/surfauna/
- Musik, Zene https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/musik/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/zene/ · StudioRhogo https://mauktenieb.github.io/studio/ · BakuBook https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/bakubook/ · SkopoRhogo https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/skoporhogo/ · Kapture https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/kapture/
- MiniTale, one name, one address: https://mauktenieb.github.io/3615/
- Katabase, Burrows: the presentation of Mauk Tenieb and the Korhogo world. https://mauktenieb.github.io/katabase/ · https://mauktenieb.github.io/burrows/

## The Fauna (canonical order)
- **N° 01 Unkle Maukie** (STR 7, DEX 7, INT 9, WIS 9, CHA 9, CON 7): « Decide from the dance floor of things » Panther's Crude Roar. At the table: Strikes only on the beat of a drum that quickens as the match goes on. The reigning champion.
- **N° 02 dogXim** (STR 7, DEX 9, INT 8, WIS 6, CHA 8, CON 6): « Chaos is the ladder of fuck! » Fox's Crude Jet. At the table: Reacts at the very last moment; one shot in four is a jet at full force.
- **N° 03 C7H5N3O6** (STR 9, DEX 8, INT 10, WIS 6, CHA 4, CON 7): « Efficiency is... » Golem's Oil Crush. At the table: Moves only sideways behind a huge paddle and never leaves his line.
- **N° 04 Naphta** (STR 7, DEX 8, INT 9, WIS 7, CHA 8, CON 6): « Presence is the essence of power » Reptilian Oil Blaze. At the table: Hardly moves; every fourth return is a blaze.
- **N° 05 Ts'ui Pên** (STR 5, DEX 6, INT 9, WIS 10, CHA 7, CON 6): « Infinity breathes wisdom » Butterfly's Oil Haze. At the table: A veil of butterflies hides the middle of the table.
- **N° 06 Honey Buzzard** (STR 6, DEX 8, INT 7, WIS 10, CHA 5, CON 8): « Even nothing is something that is nothing » Buzzard's Oil Rot. At the table: Alternates dead drops and smashes at random, and decays as the night goes on.
- **N° 07 Hátra Lövés** (STR 6, DEX 10, INT 5, WIS 7, CHA 6, CON 8): « Surviving is striking from behind » Archer's Crude Shot. At the table: Plays banked shots off the side rails.
- **N° 08 Croisière Noire** (STR 9, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 7, CHA 5, CON 10): « Shelter brings expansion » Hive's Crude Swarm. At the table: Covers the whole width without rest, inside a buzzing swarm.
- **N° 09 Aube** (STR 6, DEX 9, INT 7, WIS 10, CHA 7, CON 8): « Light dawns anew » Oil of the Wrathful Dawn. At the table: Her paddle widens after every point, like armour going on; her strikes leave a prismatic trail.
- **N° 10 Silent Pact** (STR 7, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 9, CHA 5, CON 8): Oath's Oil Shroud. At the table: Makes no sound on his half of the table; his paddle is nearly invisible.
- **N° 11 Maiden Call** (STR 5, DEX 7, INT 6, WIS 8, CHA 10, CON 6): « I'll come if you come » Siren's Oil Lure. At the table: Answers the rotary phone mid-rally and lets go of the paddle; while it rings, her call pulls your paddle toward the centre.
- **N° 12 Plague of Justinian** (STR 7, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 5, CHA 10, CON 8): « In contagion strength » Plague's Oil Miasma. At the table: Every exchange speeds the puck up, and a miasma spreads down the table.
- **N° 13 Poisoned Well** (STR 4, DEX 6, INT 9, WIS 10, CHA 8, CON 5): « Words are venom. Honey is the pus of the real » Venom's Oil Whisper. At the table: Alternates soft bait returns with sudden hard ones.
- **N° 14 Cadaver Synod** (STR 8, DEX 7, INT 7, WIS 8, CHA 9, CON 6): « Judgement is stronger than death! » Synod's Oil Verdict. At the table: Hits harder the further you lead.
- **N° 15 Truce** (STR 6, DEX 8, INT 8, WIS 7, CHA 8, CON 6): « Do we have an agreement? » Scales' Oil Equilibrium. At the table: Two mirrored paddles, one grey and one yellow.
- **N° 16 Auvergne** (STR 7, DEX 6, INT 8, WIS 9, CHA 9, CON 6): « Men become equal by covenant and right » Lyre's Oil Resonance. At the table: Hums before each strike: a low note means left, a high note means right.
- **N° 17 Grand Colonel** (STR 10, DEX 6, INT 5, WIS 7, CHA 9, CON 8): Wolf's Crude Slash. At the table: Diagonal smashes from rail to rail.
- **N° 18 Malika** (STR 7, DEX 5, INT 8, WIS 9, CHA 7, CON 9): « I am the debt of the fire » Ember's Oil Smoulder. At the table: Gets sharper whenever she is behind; her shots leave embers.

## Cassettes, scores, method
- [Korhogo Kuration](https://mauktenieb.github.io/insertkoin/kuration.html): the visitors' cassettes, made with the heart key of the VHS deck; one page per cassette, short addresses mauktenieb.github.io/k/<12 hex>.
- [Curators](https://mauktenieb.github.io/curators/): music put forward by eight curators, ranked and pressed onto the CURATORS cassettes of the VHS deck every Monday.
- Hall of Kave: the twenty best players of all the games (points of every game plus Koins earned), in the 3615; rules in [PALMARES.md](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/insertkoin/blob/main/PALMARES.md).
- [Method](https://github.com/MaukTenieb/method): the build guide of Insert Koin and its repos.

## Mauk Tenieb

Transmedia underground worldbuilder.

**Korhogo** is a self-proliferating Science Fiction world and an uncanny crucible-platform for: Experimental Hip-Hop, Concept Albums, Illbient, IDM, Experimental Dub. Its 18 avatars: the **Korhogo Fauna**, aka Hordalék or the Masks (Honey Buzzard/Marumero/Limulus/Chrême, Aube/Rosy Fingers, Plague of Justinian, Truce/↑héé↑è↑e, Malika/Quintina, Naphta-Kerema, Cadaver Synod, Croisière Noire, Grand Colonel, Poisoned Well, Unkle Maukie, Hátra Lövés, Maiden Call, C7H5N3O6, Silent Pact, Auvergne, Ts'ui Pên, dogXim).

Concept Albums: Experimental Hip-Hop/Dub, IDM/Braindance, Ethnotronica/Free Improvisation, Concept Soundtracks.

### Before Korhogo
Korhogo is a superb city in Ivory Coast. But before its octopus centrality in the lore — like William S. Burroughs' Tangier, a literary and existential Interzone — there was:
- The big photographic pre-lore, as it is nervous and mute: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/mauktenieb/photos_by)
- Budapest, 2008–2012 and 2021: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/mauktenieb) and its side galleries: [route6166](https://www.instagram.com/route6166) · [gorbuzsadr](https://www.instagram.com/gorbuzsadr) · [mauktenieb2](https://www.instagram.com/mauktenieb2) · [mauktenieb3](https://www.instagram.com/mauktenieb3)
- A testimony of the French years: [Flickr](https://www.flickr.com/people/mauktenieb/)
